dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Hmm... I see this hut is built from wooden stakes, lashed together nice and tight with a rope. It's really sturdy...

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Looks like you know what you're doing! I don't have anything else to add.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Next time we go camping, let's try and set up a tent that's just as strong as this!
